scripts.start: rm -rf .esbuild && bash scripts/with-local-env.sh npx serverless offline --httpPort 8800 --websocketPort 8801 --noPrependStageInUrl
scripts.package:dev: yarn prepare:ffmpeg-layer && bash scripts/with-local-env.sh npx serverless package --stage dev
scripts.deploy:dev: yarn prepare:ffmpeg-layer && bash scripts/with-local-env.sh npx serverless deploy --stage dev
scripts.deploy:prod: yarn prepare:ffmpeg-layer && bash scripts/with-local-env.sh npx serverless deploy --stage prod
